result.summary: Found 2 visual issues: one major layout overlap where the bottom navigation covers feed content, and one minor truncation issue in the horizontal restaurant row.

issues.description: The fixed bottom navigation bar overlaps the restaurant list, partially hiding the next card's image/content at the bottom of the screen.
issues.suggestion: Add sufficient bottom padding/margin to the scrollable content so the last visible items are not covered by the navigation bar.

issues.description: In the horizontal 'Fastest near you' row, the third restaurant card is cut off at the right edge, with its title only partially visible.
issues.suggestion: Increase side padding or adjust the carousel spacing so partially visible cards look intentional and text is not awkwardly clipped.
